text.text: Their food was absolutely delicious. I had chicken and waffles and tried their orange sunrise drink. It was a meal that I definitely enjoyed. The staff was very kind to assist me in getting my order.

text.text: Love this place. Great food and vibe. Not the cheapest - ntd1940 for 2 mains, 2 add-ons, 2 drinks, 1 dessert. Flat iron steak risotto -- tasted like rice in Chinese broth but so good. Steak was tasty and reasonably juicy too. Fish and chips was not bad, fried on the spot, love the thick and evenly cooked potato wedges. Add on salad and pork chop weren't big portions, but were well executed. Loved that the salad dressing was put on the side. Tie guan yin cocktail was creamy, sweet, floral, and had enough alcohol. Wheat ale was smooth. Tiramisu didn't taste authentic but was enjoyable, not a huge portion but just nice as an after dinner dessert. Restaurant played Jay Chou songs, familiar 2000s tunes. Service was adequate. Loved the vibe. We were seated near the door, couple of flying insects around us. Overall a pretty decent eatery for those who miss western food in Taiwan.

text.text:
Had dinner here with wife after a disappointing yet expensive lunch at Jiufen. Wanted more meat and some beer near our hotel, so decided on this. It claims to be a Louisiana restaurant, but I'd say it's Louisiana inspired. It's like saying Olive Garden is an authentic Italian restaurant. It's enjoyable, but probably not authentic.

Had a Flatiron steak on risotto, a fish and chips with a side of pork chop and garden salad, I had a wheat ale which is 1 for 1 all day, and my wife had a tieguanyin cocktail. We enjoyed everything. The steak was tender, dinner medium rare, and the risotto was tasty as well, but let's not kid ourselves - it's more like mui fan than risotto. We enjoyed it though. Fish and chips was standard, can't really get that wrong. Pork chop and garden salad was also pretty good. I liked my wheat ale, which was kinda like Blue Moon. My wife loved her cocktail too. Service was OK, but they close quite early and had to send my 2nd beer before I finished my first.

text.text: This was my first time checking out Nola's Kitchen, and the food did not disappoint. The fried chicken and waffles were a delight, and the gumbo was creamy and flavorful. I will come back and check out the rest of the menu.
